summary: Plan accessible public information, manage moderation, and measure channel outcomes. Explore this five-day practical social media course.
lede: Social media training for government agencies helps public-sector communication and engagement teams plan and assess public-facing channels. Participants practise audience-and-channel mapping, RACE-based content planning, accessible publishing checks, moderation and escalation, and AMEC-informed evaluation. These methods support coordinated service information and help teams explain how channel activity relates to communication outcomes.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who plan, publish, moderate, or evaluate public-sector social media and need practical methods for daily communications work.
modules: RACE Planning for Public Sector Social Media
prerequisites: Basic workplace digital literacy and familiarity with organisational communication processes are useful. No coding is required. You may use Excel for the reporting exercise; the course does not assume access to live social media accounts.
